## How do I add a product or service I sell?

<a id="add-item"></a>

Items are the products and services you buy and sell. Each item knows its price and which account it goes to.

**Where:** **Sales › Items** (`/items`)

1. Open Items and click "Add Item". → **Sales › Items** (`/items`)
2. Choose the kind: Service, Inventory (a product you keep in stock), Non-Inventory, Bundle (group), Other Charge or Discount. Then enter the name, Sales Price and income account.
3. Pick the item on invoices, sales receipts, purchase orders and bills.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I add a product or service I sell?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I correct inventory after a count?

<a id="adjust-inventory"></a>

Adjust inventory records a physical count or a change in value, and posts the difference to the ledger for you.

**Where:** **Operations › Adjust inventory** (`/inventory-ops`)

1. Open Adjust inventory. → **Operations › Adjust inventory** (`/inventory-ops`)
2. Physical Count: pick the item, enter the Counted Quantity and Count Date, then "Record Count". Batch Count does many items from a worksheet.
3. Value Adjustment changes what the stock is worth without changing the quantity.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I correct inventory after a count?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I see what I have in stock and what it is worth?

<a id="inventory-status"></a>

The Inventory Center shows each item’s quantity on hand; Inventory Valuation shows what the stock is worth.

**Where:** **Operations › Inventory Center** (`/inventory-center`)

1. Open the Inventory Center for quantities, reorder points and each item’s activity. → **Operations › Inventory Center** (`/inventory-center`)
2. Open Inventory Valuation for the value of what is on hand. → **Reports › Inventory Valuation** (`/reports/inventory-valuation`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I see what I have in stock and what it is worth?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I build a product from parts?

<a id="build-assemblies"></a>

Build products turns component items into a finished item, using its bill of materials.

**Where:** **Operations › Build products** (`/assemblies`)

1. Add the finished product and its parts as items. → **Sales › Items** (`/items`)
2. Open Build products and pick the product under "Select Assembly Item". Under Bill of Materials, "Add Component" for each part with its quantity per assembly, then "Save BOM". → **Operations › Build products** (`/assemblies`)
3. Under Build / Unbuild, enter the Quantity and build. "Queue as Pending" holds a build until the parts are in stock; Finalize it from Pending Builds.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I build a product from parts?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I give some customers different prices?

<a id="customer-pricing"></a>

Customer Pricing sets a special price for one customer on one item; Pricing rules changes prices automatically, for example 10% off for a group or a sale price for a date range.

**Where:** **Operations › Customer Pricing** (`/customer-pricing`)

1. Open Customer Pricing and click "Set Price". Pick the customer and the item and enter the Custom Price. → **Operations › Customer Pricing** (`/customer-pricing`)
2. Open Pricing rules and click "New rule" for automatic changes: who and what it applies to, and the price change. → **Sales › Pricing rules** (`/advanced-pricing`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I give some customers different prices?", or ask Ask AI.*
